plan.contextChunk: This figure is a single horizontal strip in which one camera is repeated five times in a row on a white ground, with thick red arrows between and around the copies. Each camera is a black wireframe viewing frustum in three-quarter view: a solid black dot marks the projection center at the left, four straight edges spread rightward from it to the corners of a tall rectangle standing for the image plane, and a faint vertical line inside that rectangle marks its midline. All five frusta match in size and orientation, and every one opens toward the right. A red arrow lies on the axis left of the first camera, another sits in each gap between consecutive cameras, and a final one continues past the last camera to the right edge; all arrowheads point right. Because the arrows run in the same direction the frusta face, the strip shows a camera moving straight ahead down its own optical axis, the case in which the sideways velocity components vanish and only the component along the Z-axis is nonzero.

faint grey vertical midline inside each image-plane rectangle
six thick red arrows lying on the shared optical axis: one left of the first camera, one in each gap between cameras, one past the last camera, all pointing right (+Z direction of travel)
flow-field view (toggle alternative): flat image-plane rectangle with a center dot (focus of expansion) and red vectors radiating outward from the center toward the rectangle edges

interactionPlan.geometry_notes: STRIP VIEW: five frusta spaced 3.2 units apart along +X (screen-right), each identical. Frustum: projection-center dot (black sphere, radius 0.09) at local origin; four edges (thin black cylinders/lines) run 1.6 units rightward to the corners of a rectangle 2.4 tall × 1.6 wide, drawn as black wireframe edges with a faint grey (#999999) vertical midline. Six red (#e02020) arrows, each ~2.0 long with a triangular head, lie along the central horizontal axis: one before the first frustum, one in each of the four gaps, one after the last. Strip spans roughly x ∈ [-2, 17], y ∈ [-1.3, 1.3]. All frusta open toward +X; orientation identical. FLOW VIEW: a single front-facing rectangle 6 × 4 units (black outline) with a black center dot; ~16 red arrows radiating from the center toward points on/near the rectangle border, each arrow's length proportional to its radial distance from center. Colors: black wireframe on white, red arrows only.
interactionPlan.notes: Keep both views in the scene and show/hide on toggle. For the strip view, highlight the active frustum (time slider) with a slightly thicker stroke or subtle red tint; the animation loops a moving frustum traveling the full strip. In the flow view, animate arrows pulsing outward from the center to reinforce expansion. Render frustum edges as LineSegments with black LineBasicMaterial; arrows as cylinder + cone meshes in red.
